Ana: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR with new function/tool-calling examples that exercise structured JSON outputs. Need eyes on the guardrail wording and the SDK snippet for the Python client.
Sam: Link? happy to skim, got a small window.
Ana: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — the main things: 1) show schema + example output, 2) tiny migration note for v2 tool-calling, 3) a short Python snippet that uses `client.call_tool(...)` and `response.parse_json()`
Kate: skimmed. The JSON schema example needs an additional `required` on `items` to avoid ambiguous empty arrays. Example: ```json
{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","required":["id"]}}
```
Cheng: Also flagging the SDK breaking-change note — users upgrading from 1.x might rely on implicit string parses. Suggest adding a one-line before/after diff for the Python snippet to make rollback easy.
Sam: docs-bot preview link failed for me earlier, saw a netlify 500. Can anyone re-run the preview?
docs-bot: Deploy preview queued — https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.example (checks running) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ana: thanks, Kate & Cheng. I'll add the `required` fix and a before/after code block for migration.
Ana: small question — do we want to show a quick JS snippet too, or keep this PR Python-only and follow up with JS?
Kate: keep it Python-only for now, adds clarity. We can link to a follow-up JS issue.
Cheng: +1. I'll add a note in the PR comments about test prompts to catch empty-array regressions.
Sam: LGTM after the tiny schema fix.
Ana: I'll push the edits in ~30m and ping again. Thanks all :pray:
